description: See how explicit curly braces and aligned indentation make the structure of a nested if statement inside a for loop unmistakable.

steps.description: Start with the outer for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) loop on line 1 and its matching closing brace aligned in column 1 on line 5.
Indent the inner if (i%2 == 0 && i%3 == 0) one level inside the loop, wrap its body in explicit curly braces { ... }, and indent line 3 one level further.

steps.answer: Because lines 2 and 4 enclose the if body in curly braces, every statement between them runs only when i%2 == 0 && i%3 == 0 is true.
steps.question: If you add another statement between lines 3 and 4 inside the curly braces, when will it execute?

steps.description: Step into line 3 when i = 0 to see the braced if body print '0 is divisible by 6'.

title: Consistent Braces and Indentation in Nested Blocks
